parts.text: I keep the shared picture of the airspace by working with the network of flight corridors between sites, the zones that group them, and the closures announced by the authorities. When a closure is entered, I want to know how much disruption it caused across customers. A closure can come into force while drones of several companies are already in the air, and closures are often announced as planned ones with a start and end time, or sudden ones that apply at once, and they are often amended during the day.
